newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign firms registered capital in Shanghai up.
newsitem.headline: Foreign firms registered capital in Shanghai up.

text.p: The registered capital of foreign-funded firms in Shanghai surged 29.07 percent during the first seven months of this year, topping all other sectors of the economy, Xinhua news agency reported on Wednesday.
The agency said the registered capital of private businesses increased by 23.36 per cent, while the state-owned sector registered a decline for the first time.

It quoted analysts as saying the quick growth in foreign capital was due to the increasing profitability of the Shanghai market, while the growing enthusiasm of local residents for investment was responsible for the expansion of private firms.

The fall in registered capital in the state sector was the result of a tightening of capital auditing measures and an increase in bankruptcies, the agency said, but gave no indication of the extent of the decline.
